items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the education law, in relation to requiring school districts
to provide information regarding water safety and swimming certification to
certain parents or students upon enrollment
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S1349

SPONSOR: CLEARE
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the education law, in relation to requiring school
districts to provide information regarding water safety and swimming
certification to certain parents or students upon enrollment

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

The purpose of this bill is to require school districts to provide
parents and guardians with information about water safety education
courses and swimming lessons, promoting water safety awareness and
potentially reducing water-related injuries and fatalities among chil-
dren.

 
SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:

Section 1. Amends Section 3205 of the education law by adding a new
subdivision that requires school districts, beginning with the 2025-2026
school year, to provide information to parents or guardians about the
importance of water safety courses and swimming lessons.  This informa-
tion must be offered electronically or in hard copy and include local
options for age-appropriate water safety courses and swimming lessons,
highlighting free or reduced-price options.

Section 2. Sets the effective date of the act as July 1, 2024.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

Drowning is one of the leading causes of accidental death among young
children. Educating parents and guardians about water safety and the
availability of swimming lessons can play a crucial role in prevention.
By informing parents and guardians about the benefits of and options for
water safety education, this bill aims to increase participation in
these programs.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

Minimal.

 
SOCIETAL IMPACT:

Potential reduction of water-related injuries and fatalities.

 
ECONOMIC AND EMPLOYMENT IMPACT:

Stimulation of economic activity in the sector of water safety education
and swimming instruction.

 
ENVIRONMENTAL AND INFRASTRUCTURAL IMPACT:

Minimal.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New Bill.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect on July 1, 2025.
